equation lmct stateNi2+ + hν → Ni+ + h+_VB. The charge-transfer excitation is described as a central Ni+ ion with an electrostatically bound valence-band hole having hydrogen-like character.author derivedSource-reported observationnischwartz2003 · Main PDF p. 10, printed p. 13214, Equation 4
equation optical electronegativityE_LMCT = 30000 cm−1[χopt(L) − χopt(M)] + ΔSPE + 10Dq. χopt values use the source optical/Pauling-scale relationship; 10Dq accounts for excitation into the antibonding t2 set.author derivedSource-reported observationreferenceschwartz2003 · Main PDF p. 10, printed p. 13214, Equation 5
equation spin pairing energySPE = [<S(S+1)> − S(S+1)]D.author derivedSource-reported observationreferenceschwartz2003 · Main PDF p. 10, printed p. 13214, Equation 6a
equation spin pairing parameterD = (7/6)[(5/2)B + C]. B and C are Racah repulsion parameters from ligand-field data; this D differs from the zero-field-splitting notation used elsewhere.author derivedSource-reported observationreferenceschwartz2003 · Main PDF p. 10, printed p. 13214, Equation 6b
